purpose: One executable source of truth for the accepted Miro harness order.

ordered_path.implementation: Use the already frozen retrieval candidates for this replay.
Use only the already owner-visible local excerpts; do not publish their text.
Treat each retrieved excerpt as a raw candidate, not as an answer.
Qwen3-Reranker-4B Q4_K_M compares the unchanged question with each raw excerpt. TAKE and NOT_SURE continue; DROP stops.
Only after step 5, Qwen3-8B writes atomic claims and selects existing evidence IDs.
Ordinary code resolves selected IDs to exact source text and rejects invented IDs.
DeBERTa checks whether the exact source context entails each claim. Neutral and contradiction stop.
Ordinary code keeps only grounded claims and preserves separate versions.
Qwen3-8B writes a short answer from accepted claims only.
Ordinary code requires every factual answer to cite an accepted evidence ID; otherwise it fails closed.
Return the answer or the fixed no-supported-information response.

forbidden_orders: Qwen claim extraction before raw-excerpt reranking
question-to-Qwen-written-claim relevance as a substitute for raw-excerpt reranking
DeBERTa as the only relevance or truth judge
writer access to rejected raw excerpts
claim_boundary: This contract makes the accepted middle and final path executable. The private replay freezes the earlier discovery output instead of rerunning the local index. It is not yet a new desktop build or a physical swarm test.
